values./system/description:
Your physical and energy Damage Resistance increase on all hit locations based on your STR. You do not gain this benefit while wearing Power Armor.

  • STR 7–8: +1 physical and energy DR
  • STR 9–10: +2 physical and energy DR
  • STR 11+: +3 physical and energy DR

Requirements: STR 7, Level 4+, not a robot
